info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Quality Assurance API
info.description: The Product Quality Assurance API enables businesses to efficiently assess and verify the quality of their banking products. By utilizing this API, organizations can access detailed quality metrics and compliance information for specific products. Ideal for quality control teams and product managers, it facilitates informed decision-making and ensures adherence to industry standards. This API supports proactive measures in quality assurance, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction and trust. Developers can integrate this functionality into their systems to streamline the product quality assessment workflow.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about the product quality assurance record with the specified ID. It ensures that users have access to the most up-to-date quality assurance data related to the product.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the retrieval of product quality assurance details based on the specified product ID. It must contain the necessary parameters required to fetch the pertinent information about the product quality assurance process.

200.description: Successfully retrieved product quality assurance information.

GetProductQualityAssuranceByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations related to product quality assurance in the product management system.
